name: Code playground
description: Code editor with Run, Stop, Reset and Copy, plus a console. Emits code.run {language, source}; shows run.status and serial events from other elements.

name: Finance lab
description: Sliders, a live chart and KPIs for growth, loan and fee models. Runs learner JavaScript in a Web Worker and checks it against reference functions.

name: Microcontroller board scene
description: 3D board and breadboard with clickable parts, labels and a pin simulator. Runs Arduino sketches from a code playground in the browser, or through settings.runner when one is bound.

runner.description: Optional runner name; default translates in the browser
